relations.text: 子会社のISE Labsと、HPCおよびAI向けのウエハーレベルのテスト・バーンインサービスで戦略的提携を発表した
relations.text_en: Aehr announced a strategic partnership with ISE Labs to deliver wafer-level test and burn-in services for HPC and AI applications

source.label: Aehr の発表
source.quote: Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR), a worldwide supplier of semiconductor test and burn-in solutions, today announced a strategic partnership with ISE Labs, Inc., a leading provider of semiconductor engineering services, to deliver advanced wafer-level test and burn-in services tailored for high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) applications.
source.note: 子会社ISE Labsを通じた関係です。
source.note_en: Relationship runs through its subsidiary ISE Labs.

relations.text: ISE Labsは、ASEの子会社である
relations.text_en: ISE Labs is a subsidiary of ASE

source.label: Aehr の発表
source.quote: ISE Labs is a subsidiary of ASE, Inc., the world’s leading provider of outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) services.

relations.text: ISE Labsは、シリコンフォトニクス向けウエハーレベルバーンインのFOX-NPシステムを最初に購入した試験所である
relations.text_en: ISE Labs was the first lab to purchase Aehr's FOX-NP system for wafer-level burn-in of silicon photonics devices

source.label: Aehr の発表
source.quote: ISE Labs was also the first lab to purchase Aehr’s FOX-NP™ system for wafer-level burn-in of silicon photonics devices
source.note: 子会社ISE Labsを通じた関係です。
source.note_en: Relationship runs through its subsidiary ISE Labs.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
